tool_review: Reviewed full relation preservation at focus boundaries, required build selection for runtime focus, per-call execution identity, parent linkage, typed membership, and absolute-before-resolve CLI roots. Eight whitebox and eight focus/bundle tests passed; application rules and previous expectations unchanged. Reviewed full-model search including collapsed parameters, aliases and notes. Result selection reveals only ancestors; existing node positions and expanded regions stay unchanged. Real ELK and search regression passed. Search only changes the view. Actual browser search revealed duplicate parameter captions; reviewed the view-only fix adding the owning node, direction and type. No model or business expectation changed. Independent app review found historical reevaluations can share a revision. Template now selects the first exact parent-frame boundary, withholds events when it is missing, and excludes final result/disposition/qualification from past state. Source links for captured fields use the owning function. Regression covers renamed parent, same-revision future evidence and missing frames. Initial test variable name collision was fixed before the passing run. Independent UI trial found inputs split between enter/return. Values now merge only for matching explicit call/run/attempt/entity/build/model/version identity; legacy attempt:node IDs and incomplete identity retain last-event-only behavior. Counterexamples cover each identity boundary.
